data.name: Eda
data.gender_notes: Eda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Eda was a goddess of fertility and childbirth. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'edaō', meaning 'to give'. In Christianity, Eda is a variant of the name Edith, which means 'wealth, prosperity' or 'rich in grace'. The name Eda carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eda usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the nurturing and loving nature of a mother.
data.etymology: Eda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eda total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
